transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Well, I came in because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I know what's actually going on. I know they have been watching my moves at work. They keep changing the pallet counts on my shifts to mess up my numbers, just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot.
Have you ever seen, heard, or felt things that others around you don’t seem to notice?

Yeah, I mean... sometimes. Like when I'm working down in the aisle, or even just at home folding clothes, I'll hear a man's voice. It's clear as day. He just tells me, "Nicole, check it again." But there's never anybody near me when it happens. So, yeah, I guess other people don't hear it.
Do you believe that people are plotting against you or trying to harm you in any way? Like they have some plan or agenda against you that you can't stop?

Well, yeah, like I was saying earlier about the warehouse. They definitely have a plan. My husband and the people at work keep acting like I'm crazy for saying it, but I know for a fact they're watching my every move. They're doing it on purpose—changing my pallet counts on my shifts. It's their agenda to keep me from getting that supervisor spot, and it feels like no matter how hard I work, I can't stop them from messing with my numbers.
Do you feel like you have a special role or importance that others don't recognize, like you're meant for something bigger that other people don't understand?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I just want that supervisor job because I've earned it, not because I'm meant for something bigger or anything like that. I just want what's fair. I'm just a regular person trying to do my job, but they won't let me.
Have you ever felt like things in the environment—like things on TV, radio, or even strangers’ actions—were directed at you personally, even if others didn’t see it that way?

No, not really. I mean... the TV is just the TV. I don't think anyone on the radio is talking to me or anything like that. It's really just the people at the warehouse that I know are messing with me. Strangers out in public don't really pay any attention to me, so... no, I haven't noticed anything like that.

Have you ever felt that events happening around you—like things happening in the news, things people say in public, or random events—were somehow connected to you or meant something specific for you, even if others didn’t see it that way?

No, I don't think so. I mean, it's not the news or random things like that. Like I said before, it's just the warehouse people. My husband and everyone at work keep acting like I'm crazy for bringing it up, but I know for a fact they've been watching my every move and changing my pallet counts. They're doing it specifically to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. It's not some random event in the world, it's them.
Do you ever feel like your thoughts, feelings, or actions are being controlled by outside forces, like someone or something is making you do things against your will?

No, I don't feel like that at all. I mean, I'm the one making my own decisions. Nobody is controlling my thoughts or making me do anything against my will. The people at the warehouse are just messing with my work, but they aren't, like, controlling my mind or my body. I'm in full control of myself.
Have you ever had any unusual beliefs about your identity, abilities, or purpose that others don’t seem to share or understand?

No, not at all. I mean, I'm just a regular person. I don't think I have any special powers or some big secret purpose, if that's what you're asking. I'm just trying to go to work and earn that supervisor position. There's nothing unusual about who I am.

Have you ever felt that certain events, actions, or behaviors of people around you—outside of the warehouse—had a special meaning or were directed at you personally, even if others didn’t see it that way?

No, it's really just the warehouse. Like I said, I came in because my husband and the people at work keep acting like I'm crazy for bringing it up. But I know they've been watching my every move and changing the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. It's not people outside of work or random events, it's just them.
Have you ever believed in something that you know other people might find strange or impossible, like something that couldn’t happen in the real world?

No, I don't believe in anything impossible like that. The only thing is what I've been saying. I'm here because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy for bringing it up. But it's not impossible—it's actually happening. I know they've been watching my every move and changing the pallet counts just to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. That's the only thing going on.
Do you feel like people are spying on you, following you, or trying to harm you in some way beyond what's happening at the warehouse?

No, it's really just the warehouse and my husband. I mean, I don't think anyone is following me down the street or anything like that. It's just... I came in today because my husband and the people at work keep acting like I'm crazy for bringing it up. But I know they've been watching my every move at work, and they're changing the pallet counts on purpose. They're just doing it to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. That's all it is. Nobody else is after me.
Have you ever believed that you were someone special or important, like you had a unique role or identity that others didn't know about, even if they didn't see it that way?

No, I don't think I'm anyone special or famous or anything like that. I'm just a regular person trying to do my job. Like I've been saying, the only thing going on is the situation at work. I'm only here because my husband and the people at the warehouse keep telling me I'm crazy when I talk about it. But I'm not crazy. I know they're watching everything I do and messing with the pallet counts. They just don't want me to get that supervisor spot, that's all. I don't have any secret identity or anything.
Outside of the warehouse situation, have you ever had any other strong beliefs that others don’t share, like being watched or targeted in other areas of your life?

No, really, it's just what I've been saying. Outside of work and my husband, I don't feel like anyone else is watching me or targeting me. I'm just... I'm just here because they keep acting like I'm crazy for talking about it. But I know what's happening. They're watching everything I do at the warehouse and messing with those pallet counts. They just don't want me to get that supervisor spot. That's the only thing going on.
Have you ever had any beliefs or suspicions about people outside of the warehouse targeting you or acting against you in some way?

No, I haven't. I feel like I keep repeating myself, but it's really just the warehouse. I only came in today because my husband and the people at work keep acting like I'm crazy when I try to talk about it. But I'm not. I know for a fact they've been watching my every move at work and changing the pallet counts on me. They're just trying to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. That's the only thing happening. Nobody outside of work is doing anything to me.
Is your belief that people at the warehouse are trying to harm or undermine you the only situation where you feel targeted or watched, or have you had similar feelings in other parts of your life?

I feel like a broken record here, doc. Yes, it is just the warehouse. Like I keep saying, I really only came in to see you because my husband and the guys at work won't stop acting like I've lost my mind. But I know what I see. They've been watching every single move I make on the floor and changing my pallet counts on purpose. They just want to make sure I don't get that supervisor spot. That's it. There's nobody else doing anything to me anywhere else.
Have you ever had any other unusual or strange beliefs that you know most people wouldn't agree with or understand, even if they weren't related to the warehouse?

Look, doctor, I don't know how many different ways I can say no to that. I don't have any other strange beliefs. Like I've been telling you, the only reason I even came in here is because my husband and the warehouse people keep acting like I'm crazy. But I'm not crazy. I just know they have been watching my moves and changing the pallet counts to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. That is the only thing going on, plain and simple.
